value.rationale: Motivated by Poisson-activated dimer and the source’s stiff-bond escape problem, bond rupture is a natural distinct failure observable. Its stiffness-independent limiting rupture hazard and the exponentially divergent variance-matched diffusion prediction reveal a substantive, sharp failure of effective-temperature approximations, with an entire exponential first-passage law and all positive moments rather than a routine numerical increment.
